global_summary: The sheet explains why heap allocations matter in .NET/ASP.NET Core, how allocations interact with GC pauses and latency, and how to reduce allocation pressure through better data structures, capacity planning, spans/buffers/pools, and measurement-driven optimization.

regions.summary: Allocation basics: which constructs allocate on the heap, async/iterator/generic cases, why heap allocation triggers GC work, latency, shared heap synchronization, stack/heap locality, and value-vs-reference examples.
When allocation pressure matters: hidden performance costs under load, GC generations, Gen 0/1/2 behavior in ASP.NET Core, server GC, pauses and throughput/latency effects.

Optimization and runtime-collapse road: request latency spikes, shared heap in ASP.NET Core, synchronization, Gen 2 promotions, ThreadPool/GC interaction, steps to avoid promotions and reduce long-lived objects.
Final low-allocation and diagnostics road: churn, StringBuilder/reuse/pooling, when to use StringBuilder, and profiler-based allocation measurement/cautions.
